modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: From Shandong Airlines' General Conditions of Carriage effective 1 July 2026.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Each piece up to 55 cm (22 inches) long, 40 cm (16 inches) wide and 20 cm (8 inches) high, wheels and handles included. First and business class: 2 pieces; premium economy and economy: 1 piece.

carryon_weight.value: First and business class: up to 8 kg or 17 lbs per piece. Premium economy and economy: up to 5 kg or 11 lbs.

personal_item.value: 1 personal item that fits under the seat in front, such as a handbag, briefcase, laptop bag or camera bag.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Free allowance calculation is set out in separate Shandong Airlines rules; the conditions of carriage set the per-piece limits.

size_weight.value: Each checked piece must weigh at least 2 kg (4 lbs) and no more than 45 kg (99 lbs) on domestic routes or 32 kg (70 lbs) on international routes. Weight-system routes: up to 100 cm x 60 cm x 40 cm. Piece-system routes: the three dimensions may total no more than 203 cm (80 inches), wheels and handles included.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: From Shandong Airlines' General Conditions of Carriage effective 1 July 2026; where a country's law sets its own requirements, Shandong Airlines follows them.

care.value: For a delay or cancellation at the departure point caused by Shandong Airlines (mechanical failure, scheduling, crew and similar), it provides meals and accommodation. For causes outside its control (weather, air traffic control, security and similar) it helps arrange meals and accommodation at your cost. At an intermediate stop or on a diversion it provides meals and accommodation regardless of cause.

refund.value: After a flight cancellation you may choose a refund even if your ticket's conditions restrict refunds, and the refund service charge is waived.

compensation.value: For a delay caused by Shandong Airlines that occurs within 3 days before scheduled departure, passengers who bought before the delay and took the flight are compensated RMB 200 for a delay of 4 hours to less than 8 hours, and RMB 400 for 8 hours or more.

phone_home_market.value: 24-hour service hotline 95369; from abroad, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan dial +86(531)95369
